# v1.3.6

## New features

- Trying out my own market scanner
  - New tremor books prices are now scanned
  - It's currently ran on my main computer whenever it's free (which isn't too often). If [loa-buddy](https://loa-buddy.pages.dev/) has a newer figure, loa-buddy is used instead.

## Fixes & improvements

- fixed issue when a roster contains 2 names that differ only by a diacritic
- fixed a bug where paradise chests occasionally have a negative value
- added rarity backgrounds
